plan net identity across pieces: B2l bus x_u_c_u_b_u_st_g_lg_g_grp__u_lg_

[i] of this piece is the same partition net as lanes pieces g_lg_g_grp__u_lg_

[i] (bit i <-> bit i, the binder convention); compressed master-port bus = used master bits in index order (rest_wrap.py convention)

term: d_xa[9:7] are plan pins the remainder never reads (the as-built descriptor taps register them, nothing uses them): kept as registered sinks (recipe retain_unused_input_bits), no logic

vmdel.finding: B2l pins = ot_hbm_svc_vmdel_lane_n elaborated at the DEFAULT NPC 4 (physical/die_plan/hbm/cores/ports/p4_ports.json and pins_plan/inputs/rtl_ports.json: fill_v_i 4, fill_bank_i 4, fill_slot_i 24, fill_epoch_i 64, fill_data_i 1024; 1489 pins). The die as built is NPC 2: all 32 die_r18h5.v instances are #(.NPC(2)) and take 2 x 256-b fill feeds; the closed ref tile physical/ref_tile/hv18_vmdel_lane2 (kit.env PARAMS NPC=2, 2 SRAMs, gate PASS) is the hardened view; the B2l plan core_conns itself feeds each vmdel from 2 vmks cores (u_vmks_Q0, u_vmks_Q2). NPC 2 elaborates to 929 pins (fill 2/2/12/32/512). The source of the file at d34578d6f and at HEAD are identical (one revision, 6bb7c6870a).
options: HBM-ARCH re-pins the 5 vmdel tables at NPC 2 (929 pins) -> recipe as is (NPC 2) generates
an NPC 4 kit matches the pins but is a different function (4 PC slots, 2048-sector blocks, other aperture rule): REFUSED, not the die
